title: Magnetic Bead DNA/RNA Extraction Using NucleoMag Kit in 96 Well Format
author: Christopher A Hempel

steps.title: Add B-beads to lysates
steps.instruction: Add 25 µl B-beads to each lysate in well 1 using a multichannel pipette, covering other rows while pipetting. For 96 samples plus 2 buffer volumes, fill 2,450 µl B-beads into a reagent matrix.

steps.title: Add MWA2 buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add 425 µl MWA2 buffer to each sample with a multichannel pipette (covering other rows). For 96 samples plus 2 buffer volumes, fill 41.65 mL MWA2 buffer into a reagent matrix. Mix samples, buffer, and beads by pipetting 10x up and down after transfer.

steps.title: Incubate for binding
steps.instruction: Wait for 5 min to allow nucleic acids to bind to the beads.

steps.title: Capture beads with magnet
steps.instruction: Hold the magnet into well 1 and move it around for 30 seconds to catch all magnetic beads.

steps.title: Wash beads in well 2
steps.instruction: Move the magnet into well 2 and wait for 3 min. Do not discharge the cover plate to ensure beads stick to magnets and buffers interact with beads.

steps.title: Wash beads in well 3
steps.instruction: Move the magnet into well 3 and wait for 3 min.

steps.title: Wash beads in well 4
steps.instruction: Move the magnet into well 4 and wait for 3 min.

steps.title: Air dry beads
steps.instruction: Move the magnet out of well 4 and air dry the beads for 10 min.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acids in well 5
steps.instruction: Move the magnet into well 5 and wait for 10 min for nucleic acids to unbind from magnetic beads and enter final elution.

steps.title: Store eluates
steps.instruction: Cover the plate containing the eluates with foil and store in a -80 freezer (-20 is sufficient for DNA samples).

steps.title: Secondary air dry
steps.instruction: Move the magnet out of well 3 and air dry beads for 5 min.

steps.title: Digest DNA in well 6
steps.instruction: Move the magnet to well 6 and wait for 25 min for nucleic acids to unbind and DNA to be digested.

steps.title: Remove beads
steps.instruction: Remove the magnet and magnetic beads and set them aside on the drying rack.

steps.title: Prepare nucleic acids for rebinding
steps.instruction: Add 350 µl buffer MWA2 to well 6 (covering other rows), mix by pipetting 10x up and down, and wait for 5 min. For 96 samples, use 33.6 mL total (fill reagent matrix to 25 mL, use mix, then refill to 1/3rd).

steps.title: Rebind nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Move the magnet and magnetic beads back into well 6 and wait for 5 min for nucleic acids to re-bind to beads.
